description: Java source code for a Spring Boot application that sets up a device registry service using Vert.x and Spring Framework. It manages verticles, health check providers, and starts the server.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Main Spring Boot application class for device registry, managing verticles and health checks.

methods.name: setVerticles
methods.description: Setter for the list of verticles, injected via Spring.

methods.name: setHealthCheckProviders
methods.description: Setter for the list of health check providers, injected via Spring.

methods.name: deployVerticles
methods.description: Deploys verticles asynchronously, waits for all to complete.

methods.name: postRegisterServiceVerticles
methods.description: Registers additional health checks after verticles are registered.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method to start the Spring Boot application.
